name: SiteTree
purpose: consume the DWH #SITE projection, validate it and expose deterministic SiteTree runtime lookup and derived projection mechanisms

DWH: the #SITE projection contract and projection result

nodeSemantics.id: canonical SiteTree node identity supplied by #SITE
nodeSemantics.label: canonical public label supplied by #SITE
nodeSemantics.path: optional globally unique logical public path supplied by #SITE
nodeSemantics.children: ordered projected child nodes supplied by #SITE

loader.failure: DWH adapter, envelope or SiteTree validation failure rejects; no file fallback or invented hierarchy

rules: DWH is the canonical authority for relations from which #SITE is projected
site.json is not a canonical SiteTree authority
JSON may be a transport serialization but does not define identity
WebEngine validates #SITE output before creating the immutable SiteTree runtime snapshot
Navigation, breadcrumbs and sitemap are derived from the validated SiteTree snapshot
WebEngine does not infer DWH relations or inspect DWH storage internals
public means exposed or addressable and does not imply anonymous access
API and service routing remain separate machine-interface concerns
SiteTree must not infer authorization from hierarchy, paths or visibility
SiteTree node paths remain logical root paths and do not embed the active deployment prefix
HTTP transport is replaceable consumer plumbing and does not become SiteTree authority
